description: Upgrades a MinIO distributed deployment using mc admin update. MinIO handles its own coordinated rolling restart. Full rollback by pinning back to previous release tag.

dry_run.label: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Run preflight checks only — no changes applied

rollback.description: mc admin update pinned to previous version tag. MinIO explicitly supports rollback to any previous release. If erasure format changed on a major release, healing is required after rollback.
